candidates.name: A — www.tucows.com, 1996-10-22 (selected)
candidates.strengths: The earliest archived TUCOWS home page on its own domain, with the logo, name, 1996 date and copyright notice. It matches the ticket title directly.
candidates.deficiencies: This is the mirror-selection front page, not a list of software downloads, so it shows TUCOWS but not a file download. The background tile comes from a later capture.

candidates.name: B — tucows.idirect.com mirror, 1996-12-30
candidates.strengths: Says 'The UDDERLY INCREDIBLE SHAREWARE CENTER' and 'Software Listings for: Windows 95 | Windows 3.x | Macintosh', which makes a stronger shareware read. All embedded images were captured within about 3 minutes of the page.
candidates.deficiencies: A mirror host, not www.tucows.com. It has no copyright footer, carries two third-party banner ads (WinZip, SimpleNet) and a ConnectSoft ad, and leaves the right half of a 1280 px viewport empty, so a 16:9 frame would need pillarboxing.

candidates.name: C — tucows.phoenix.net mirror 'Windows 95 New Software' archive, 1996-11-17
candidates.strengths: A text changelog of software additions (e.g. 'Linkbot 2.0 Beta 11 to Browser Add-Ons').
candidates.deficiencies: Dense text with no download list, file sizes or cow ratings. The footer names a different rights holder, 'ComputerLink OnLine Inc.' The page is 7477 px tall, so framing is poor.
